raw_prompt:
subject_definitions:
- <Subject 1> is 骗子1，一名约三十五岁、高瘦修长的人类男性；长窄脸、暖浅肤色、灰绿色细长上挑双眼皮眼、高直窄鼻、薄唇，右侧鼻翼旁有小褐痣；深棕色微卷短发向后梳理，发际线两侧略高，留整齐的深棕色小胡子。保持其年龄、比例、面部结构、独特标记及整体主体身份。当前服装仅延续权威时间视觉条件已经建立的状态，不采用角色资产中的历史或默认服装进行覆盖、叠加或混合。
- <Subject 2> is 骗子2，一名约三十二岁、身高较矮且略显敦实的人类男性；圆中带方的脸、暖调浅麦色皮肤、琥珀褐色圆杏眼、较短且圆钝的鼻子、中等偏厚的嘴唇，左侧嘴角下方有明显小黑痣；栗褐色浓密短卷发从左侧分开，面部无胡须。保持其年龄、比例、面部结构、独特标记及整体主体身份。当前服装仅延续权威时间视觉条件已经建立的状态，不采用角色资产中的历史或默认服装进行覆盖、叠加或混合。

official_character_identity_lock:
参考视觉锚点是在各自时间位置确立当前人物视觉身份的首要视觉权威；官方人物描述仅作为防止跨帧身份漂移的补充约束，不得覆盖参考视觉锚点中清楚可见的身份特征。对每个 Subject，始终保持同一张脸、年龄、身体比例、发型或胡须、肤色、永久标记、身份定义配饰及整体人物唯一性，不得重新设计、美化、老化、年轻化、换脸、换色或替换人物。

稳定身份与当前服装是彼此分离的连续性领域。当前服装服从按时间排列的权威视觉条件；不得恢复、叠穿、混穿、部分露出或融合任何冲突的历史或默认服装。阴影、暗光、冷暖调色、距离、环境照明和运动模糊不得被解释为肤色、发色或服装颜色发生改变。若稳定身份细节因姿态、遮挡、距离或照明暂时不清晰，在重新可见时必须正确保持；若文本人物描述与视觉锚点中清楚可见的当前身份特征冲突，以视觉锚点为准。

姿态、表情、视线、身体朝向、空间位置和自然动作可依照当前过渡变化。只允许已建立的 <Subject 1> 与 <Subject 2>，不得复制人物、交换身份、无依据令人物出现或消失、镜像翻转左右关系、重置场景或新增人物与道具。两架脚踏织机必须保持正常结构、稳定空间位置和可操作关系；空置编织区域不得无故出现布料。禁止字幕、标题、说明文字、气泡、标志、水印、界面元素及任何画面文字。

detailed_description:
[Shot 1]

Clip-local 0.0–14.0 秒：承接 Previous AV 中两者隔着左侧织机交换会意视线的持续动作，摄影机沿既有方向继续极其平稳地缓慢横移，不越轴，不突然改变高度、焦段或运动方向。开段短暂而自然地把视觉重心由 <Subject 1> 平顺转向 <Subject 2>，但始终保留两者和织机之间的整体关系，不切换成孤立肖像，也不单独追随任何一人。

<Subject 1> 先收回投向 <Subject 2> 的视线，在左侧织机前由侧向姿态逐渐转正，使身体稳定朝向织机；双手依次、自然地移至拉动与推动操作部位，动作克制、连贯并符合坐姿下的身体力学。<Subject 2> 随后结束对视，转向右侧脚踏织机并在机前坐稳，视线下落至始终空置的编织区域，再抬起两根手指，使其悬停在虚空中的操作位置。所有身体转向和手部调度都通过自然重心转移完成，不瞬移、不跳姿势，也不改变两者已建立的左右位置。

摄影机继续横移并做轻微构图补偿，稳定保留两者作为共同视觉主体，使两架脚踏织机、关闭的房门和白昼照亮的空置编织区域逐渐完整进入同一中全景。两者完成调度后，仅保留自然呼吸、细小的手指稳定动作和极轻微的坐姿重心调整：<Subject 1> 呈现轻松、笃定而一本正经的神情；<Subject 2> 低头维持克制的会意笑容。织机可因手部接触产生极小且合理的机械响应，但不得生成布料、纱线成品或额外工具。

临近 14.0 秒时，横移平缓减速并停在 KF9 的构图位置，不产生回摆或突兀制动。<Subject 1> 与 <Subject 2> 分别稳定停留在左、右织机前的既定姿态；两架织机、关闭的房门与空置编织区域清楚可见。到达 KF9 后保持该稳定状态，不继续发展新的事件。

overall_soundscape:
维持王宫织造室内柔和、稳定的白昼室内环境底噪与轻微空间回响。摄影机移动不产生夸张机械声；身体转向和坐姿调整带来克制的衣料摩擦、座面轻响与轻微脚步或鞋底移位声。双手接触脚踏织机时产生细小的木质触碰、踏板与连接件轻微吱响，但织机不出现持续高速运转声。关闭的房门保持稳定，仅保留建筑空间自然的微弱环境声，不添加无依据的音乐或额外声源。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is 骗子1, a tall, slender human man around thirty-five with a long narrow warm-light face, gray-green upturned eyes, a high straight narrow nose, thin lips, a small brown mole beside the right nostril, swept-back short dark-brown wavy hair, and a neat dark-brown moustache. <Picture 2> supplies permanent identity only for <Subject 1>, not clothing, pose, or staging.
<Subject 2> is 骗子2, a shorter, stockier human man around thirty-two with a rounded-square warm light-tan face, amber-brown round almond eyes, a short blunt nose, moderately full lips, a distinct dark mole below the left corner of his mouth, thick short chestnut curls parted from the left, and no facial hair. <Picture 3> supplies permanent identity only for <Subject 2>, not clothing, pose, or staging.

summary:
A 14-second silent continuation in the royal palace weaving room, using one calm continuous medium-wide shot. The incoming camera direction and established axis carry through the shared opening, then the slow lateral move continues and gently settles while both seated men turn from their knowing exchange toward their respective looms and assume convincingly serious work poses.

retention_analysis:
Preserve the existing bodies, current costumes, hats, seated positions, left-right relationship, eyelines, and loom placement inherited from the previous video. <Picture 1> guides the weaving room’s architectural and daylight appearance, while the canonical scene state keeps the door closed. <Picture 4> guides the normal wooden treadle-loom structure without authorizing fabric or extra tools. The identity images apply only to permanent character identity and do not overwrite canonical staging, current costume, pose, or blocking.

detailed_description:
Continue directly from the incoming view without replaying any completed action. During the shared opening, preserve the existing camera motion, current costumes, seated postures, and the established placement of <Subject 1> on the left and <Subject 2> on the right among the two treadle looms. Once the preserved opening has passed, continue the camera’s extremely smooth lateral travel in the same direction and on the same axis, with no abrupt height, lens, or directional change. Briefly let the composition’s attention pass naturally from <Subject 1> toward <Subject 2> while retaining both men and their relationship to the looms in the ensemble view.

<Subject 1> ends his knowing glance toward <Subject 2>, relaxes his mouth into a natural closed resting position, and gradually turns from the existing side orientation to face the left loom. He remains seated in his established place and uses restrained, mechanically plausible weight shifts rather than translating across the floor. His hands move in sequence to the loom’s pulling and pushing operating areas, then settle there. His expression becomes relaxed, confident, and solemnly businesslike.

<Subject 2> then ends the exchanged glance, keeps his lips naturally closed with no speech-like articulation, and turns toward the right treadle loom while remaining seated in his established place. He settles squarely before it, lowers his gaze to the weaving area, and raises two fingers into an empty operating position, suspending them deliberately in open space. His restrained knowing smile remains nonverbal. Both men may breathe, blink, make tiny finger corrections, and perform slight seated balance adjustments, but neither changes floor position or exchanges sides.

The camera continues its slow lateral movement with subtle compositional compensation, gradually forming a balanced continuous medium-wide view that clearly includes both seated men, both stable treadle looms, the closed door, and the daylight-lit weaving areas. The weaving areas remain visibly empty throughout: no cloth, finished textile, invented material, or extra tool appears. Hand contact may cause only minute, physically credible wooden responses in the loom components; the machines never enter sustained rapid operation.

Ease the lateral move into a smooth deceleration without rebound. Finish with <Subject 1> seated at the left loom, body facing it and hands resting at the pulling and pushing controls, while <Subject 2> sits at the right loom looking down at the empty weaving area with two fingers poised in vacant space. Hold both men in their serious pretend-work postures, with the closed door and both empty loom areas clearly visible. No one speaks, vocalizes, or performs speech-like lip movement, and no subtitles or other visible text appear.

overall_soundscape:
Maintain soft daylight room ambience and restrained natural reverberation in the royal palace weaving room. Seated turns and posture adjustments produce quiet cloth movement, subtle seat sounds, and slight shoe repositioning. Hands contacting the looms produce small wooden taps and occasional mild pedal or linkage creaks, never continuous high-speed machinery. The closed door remains still. There is no human speech or human vocalization.

姿态、表情、视线、身体朝向、空间位置和自然动作可依照当前过渡变化。只允许已建立的 <Subject 1> 与 <Subject 2>，不得复制人物、交换身份、无依据令人物出现或消失、镜像翻转左右关系、重置场景或新增人物与道具。两架脚踏织机必须保持正常结构、稳定空间位置和可操作关系；空置编织区域不得无故出现布料。禁止字幕、标题、说明文字、气泡、标志、水印、界面元素及任何画面文字。

detailed_description:
[Shot 1]

Clip-local 0.0–14.0 秒：承接 Previous AV 中两者隔着左侧织机交换会意视线的持续动作，摄影机沿既有方向继续极其平稳地缓慢横移，不越轴，不突然改变高度、焦段或运动方向。开段短暂而自然地把视觉重心由 <Subject 1> 平顺转向 <Subject 2>，但始终保留两者和织机之间的整体关系，不切换成孤立肖像，也不单独追随任何一人。

<Subject 1> 先收回投向 <Subject 2> 的视线，在左侧织机前由侧向姿态逐渐转正，使身体稳定朝向织机；双手依次、自然地移至拉动与推动操作部位，动作克制、连贯并符合坐姿下的身体力学。<Subject 2> 随后结束对视，转向右侧脚踏织机并在机前坐稳，视线下落至始终空置的编织区域，再抬起两根手指，使其悬停在虚空中的操作位置。所有身体转向和手部调度都通过自然重心转移完成，不瞬移、不跳姿势，也不改变两者已建立的左右位置。

摄影机继续横移并做轻微构图补偿，稳定保留两者作为共同视觉主体，使两架脚踏织机、关闭的房门和白昼照亮的空置编织区域逐渐完整进入同一中全景。两者完成调度后，仅保留自然呼吸、细小的手指稳定动作和极轻微的坐姿重心调整：<Subject 1> 呈现轻松、笃定而一本正经的神情；<Subject 2> 低头维持克制的会意笑容。织机可因手部接触产生极小且合理的机械响应，但不得生成布料、纱线成品或额外工具。

临近 14.0 秒时，横移平缓减速并停在 KF9 的构图位置，不产生回摆或突兀制动。<Subject 1> 与 <Subject 2> 分别稳定停留在左、右织机前的既定姿态；两架织机、关闭的房门与空置编织区域清楚可见。到达 KF9 后保持该稳定状态，不继续发展新的事件。

overall_soundscape:
维持王宫织造室内柔和、稳定的白昼室内环境底噪与轻微空间回响。摄影机移动不产生夸张机械声；身体转向和坐姿调整带来克制的衣料摩擦、座面轻响与轻微脚步或鞋底移位声。双手接触脚踏织机时产生细小的木质触碰、踏板与连接件轻微吱响，但织机不出现持续高速运转声。关闭的房门保持稳定，仅保留建筑空间自然的微弱环境声，不添加无依据的音乐或额外声源。
